topic: Silver Splits From Gold as the War Premium Keeps Unwinding
hook_caption: Silver's falling harder than gold today. Here's why.
payoff: Sometimes the fastest drops aren't crashes—they're relief leaving the market.
beat1: Silver crashed ₹3,600+ per kg as Middle East ceasefire talks killed the fear premium that held prices up.
beat2: Gold stays safe-haven metal; silver's also industrial. When geopolitical fear fades, silver gets hit twice—no fear, weaker demand.
beat3: Watch COMEX silver hold above $57.52/oz tonight. Break below signals industrial buyers are backing away too.

topic: Oil Collapses ₹418 as the War Premium Unwinds in a Single Session
hook_caption: ₹418 wiped off crude oil in one day.
stat_line: War premium just reversed in a single session.
payoff: Sometimes the fastest price moves aren't about supply — they're about fear leaving the room.
beat1: Crude crashed ₹418 to ₹8,186 — a -4.86% move that kills the three-week climb toward ₹9,000.
beat2: Middle East diplomatic signals cooled overnight. Traders dumped the 'war risk premium' they'd been holding since last week.
beat3: Watch if WTI holds above $84 today. A break means fear-driven buying is finally done, not just paused.

topic: Oil at $99.92 and Gold Selling Off — The Market Is Splitting
hook_caption: Oil at $100 but your gold is crashing instead
payoff: When geopolitics gets scarier, gold sometimes falls. That's how bad things are.
beat1: Brent crude hit $99.92 overnight—highest in months—as Middle East supply fears spike, while gold dropped 2.44% globally as investors sold safety to cover losses elsewhere.
beat2: Fear shifted from 'world is unstable' to 'I need cash now'—so traders unwound gold positions and poured money into energy instead.
beat3: Watch if COMEX gold holds above $4,045 through US close. Below that, the safe-haven bid is genuinely broken, not just paused.
